target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures cover the Board's authorization of a $25 billion common stock repurchase program. 2023 describes the authorization in Oct 2021 and modifications in Sept 2023. 2024 describes the new authorization in July 2024 replacing the previous one. They share the specific topic of the authorized repurchase program.

The 2023 disclosure (bac_2023_7_D166) includes details on actual repurchases made during the year ($4.6 billion) and remaining authority. The 2024 disclosure (bac_2024_7_D175) reports actual repurchases made during 2024 ($13.1 billion). Both relate to the execution of repurchase programs authorized by the Board.
